summary.text: Shawn Fluharty is the Democratic candidate for West Virginia State Senate District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he has served in the West Virginia House of Delegates since 2015 and currently represents House District 5, a seat he is not seeking again in 2026.

paragraphs.text: Shawn Fluharty was born in Wheeling, West Virginia.

He earned a B.S. in public relations with a minor in political science from the West Virginia University Perley Isaac Reed School of Journalism in 2006 and a J.D. from West Virginia University's College of Law in 2009.
His career experience includes working as an attorney.
Fluharty won election to the House of Delegates in District 3 in 2014, when he and Holli Smith defeated Dave Palmer in the general election for the district's two seats.
He was re-elected in 2016, 2018 and 2020, and in 2022 he won District 5 over Brooke McArdle, then won re-election there in 2024 over Thomas Salkovick.
In the 2023-2024 session he served as Minority Vice-Chair of both the House Judiciary Committee and the House Rules Committee.
He advanced from the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary for Senate District 1 as the only candidate on the ballot and faces Republican incumbent Laura Wakim Chapman in November.
